name: bifrost-copilot-provider
description: Copilot Chat model provider for a self-hosted Bifrost LLM gateway, with automatic model and context-size discovery.

bifrost.baseUrl.description: Base URL of your Bifrost gateway, e.g. https://bifrost.example.com

bifrost.contextSizeOverrides.description: Some Bifrost providers (e.g. ollama, custom OpenAI-compatible providers) report no context-size metadata at all, so a conservative default is used instead. Use this to correct it. Keys can be an exact model id (e.g. "ollama/llama3.1") or a provider prefix (e.g. "ollama") used when no exact key matches. Values are the model's max input tokens.
